sql: SELECT b.account_hash, b.vendor_id, b.bank_account_id, b.status, v.legal_name FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = b.vendor_id WHERE b.account_hash IN (SELECT account_hash FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account GROUP BY account_hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) > 1) LIMIT 50
